title: Unit Review: Forms of Address and Scorza
goal: Review forms of address, regional words and polite requests, through a text about Manuel Scorza.
grammar: Unit Review: Forms of Address and Scorza

items: I can read a short text about Manuel Scorza and his novel Redoble por Rancas.
I can choose between *tú*, *usted* and recognise *vos*.
I can make a request polite and formal.
